For most people, a free combo works best: **OnyX** for maintenance and **AppCleaner** or **Pearcleaner** for removing apps.
Pearcleaner also finds and removes app leftovers, which makes uninstalling cleaner than dragging an app to the Trash.
If you want a one-time paid option, **DaisyDisk** is the usual pick for seeing where your space went.
**GrandPerspective (free):** A good choice for finding huge files, as it offers a visual treemap, though its interface is functional but dated.
**MacDiskCleaner (free with a one-time upgrade):** It scans your whole Mac and shows every result for free, including junk, duplicates, and large or old files.
**Crumb (one-time $9):** This is an all-in-one menu-bar app.
Things to avoid: CleanMyMac X has moved to a subscription model
Aiseesoft Mac Cleaner is subscription only, and each purchase attaches a trial that auto-renews unless you cancel it.
**AppCleaner (by FreeMacSoft)** — *Best for removing apps & leftover junk*
*Alternative:* **Pearcleaner** (Open-source, modern UI, available on GitHub).
**OnyX (by Titanium Software)** — *Best for deep system maintenance*
### 2. Best for Reclaiming Disk Space: **DaisyDisk**
*(Free alternative:* **OmniDiskSweeper** or **GrandPerspective**, though their interfaces are much more spartan.)*

### 3. Best "All-in-One" Dashboard: **BuhoCleaner**
While **CleanMyMac** is the most recognizable cleaner, it heavily pushes an annual subscription.
The best all-around choice is **Audio Plugin Uninstaller** by Wide Blue Sound.

**Plugin Station** (paid, about $165 one-time) has an uninstall assistant for clean plugin removal, plus update notifications. It's a broader plugin manager, so it's worth it mainly if you buy plugins often.
**UninstallPKG** is free. One user on a forum said it does the same work as Audio Plugin Uninstaller but it's free. It's most useful for plugins installed from packages.
**Bypass** scans for VST, AU, AAX and CLAP plugins and deletes the plugin file from its corresponding folder. It's simpler, but it may not clean up support files the way a receipt-based tool does.
The best and most effective tool specifically designed for this purpose is **Audio Plugin Uninstaller by Wide Blue Sound**.
Best for Disabling & Offloading: **Plugoff (by Midifex)**
Best for Companion Apps: **AppCleaner (by FreeMacSoft)**
